# Custom Tattoo & Piercing Studio in Pretoria

> Custom tattoo and piercing in Pretoria, by private appointment or on location. Get an indicative range in minutes, then book. WhatsApp 061 759 3378.

Private tattoo and piercing studio trading as **Haywood Tattoos and Piercings**, with a flagship in Pretoria Central and a second studio in Mabopane, Gauteng, South Africa.
Custom work is quoted as an **indicative range** built from the client brief — the artist confirms the final quote before a design is locked.
Tattoo sessions run by appointment; standard piercings can sometimes be taken as a walk-in when a slot is open (most likely on a Friday).

## Services

- Custom tattoos: New pieces, cover-ups, touch-ups, blackwork, illustrative, fine-line, colour, and larger projects.
- Piercing: Ear lobe and cartilage (helix, tragus, conch), nose, tongue, belly and dermal anchors, with implant-grade jewelry and aftercare you can actually follow. Surface piercings are not offered.
- Mobile sessions: Bring the private Haywood experience to your space. Travel availability and fees are confirmed in your brief.

## Piercing Fridays (standing weekly rate)

- Piercing Fridays: Selected nose, ear lobe and belly piercings at the Friday rate — R100 to R150, between 10:00 and 15:00. Appointment only, capped at 20 slots.
- Rate: R100–R150 · eligible: Nose · Ear lobe · Belly
- Weekend perk: book a piercing on Saturday or Sunday and a temporary tooth gem is on the studio — subject to stock and artist sign-off.
- Conditions: Selected nose, ear and belly piercings at the Friday rate · appointment only, capped per session · jewelry subject to stock · 18+ with valid ID or guardian consent · the artist confirms the price at the chair

## Indicative pricing

- Studio minimum: R1,800 — The floor for any custom piece, including small blackwork. It covers the design time, setup, sterilisation and the first hour on the chair.
- Session rate: R1,200 /hour — Applied once you are past the minimum. Long days are quoted as a project, not clocked hour by hour.
- Deposit: 30% — Taken from the lower end of your range to hold the date, then credited back against the final price.
- Mobile travel: R350 — Within Pretoria and roughly 30 km around it. Anything further gets quoted with you before it is booked.
- Adds: R700 – R1,400 — Medium and large sizes and high-detail work move the number up. Colour work adds about R700.

## Live studio special

- Spring sitting special: Ten per cent off any custom piece quoted from R4,000, for weekday studio sessions booked before the end of November. (10% off quotes from R4000, running until 2026-11-30). Applied automatically to the indicative range; still confirmed by the artist.

## Lookbook (ready or adaptable artwork)

- Serpent / Sun Study — Adaptable concept, R 3,800 – R 5,200
- Red Altar — Ready-to-book flash, R 2,900
- Thorn Eye — Repeatable study, R 2,200 – R 3,100

## Aftercare (general guidance, not medical advice)

- Fresh tattoo: covering off after 3–5 hours, gentle wash twice daily, thin moisturiser for about two weeks, no picking, no swimming or direct sun for six weeks, SPF 50 once healed.
- Fresh piercing: sterile saline once or twice daily, do not twist or remove jewelry, avoid friction, no swimming during healing. Lobes around 6 weeks, cartilage 3–9 months.
- The studio does not diagnose or treat infections or reactions — anyone concerned should see a clinician.

## Policies that shape a quote

- Deposit: 30% of the lower end of the range, credited to the final price.
- Cover-ups and touch-ups: subject to assessment from clear daylight photos.
- Designs remain the artist's intellectual property; the tattoo belongs to the client.
- Payments run through a hosted Yoco checkout; the studio never stores card data. Cards, debit and mobile pay are accepted at both locations.
